events.verdict: [Observable in enhanced video] Aminu (POR) has a foot in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Jokic (DEN) makes marginal contact with Turner (POR) that does not prevent him from getting to the rebound.
Aminu (POR) makes contact with Millsap's (DEN) arms and affects his ability to control the rebound.
Turner (POR) has an extended forearm placed on Jokic (DEN) above the free throw line extended.
Turner (POR) makes marginal contact to the body of Jokic (DEN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Nurkic (POR) sets the pick in Beasley's (DEN) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.

Millsap (DEN) makes marginal contact with Nurkic's (POR) body before making clean contact with the ball during his shot attempt near the rim. All available angles show Millsap does not make contact with Nurkic's face.
Jokic (DEN) makes incidental contact with Lillard (POR) that does not prevent him from getting to the rebound.
Nurkic (POR) makes contact to Jokic's (DEN) arm and affects his SQBR.
Jokic (DEN) makes marginal contact with Nurkic (POR) that does not affect his ability to defend.
Turner (POR) makes marginal contact to the body of Murray (DEN) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Craig (DEN) makes marginal contact with Lillard (POR) during the inbound.
Beasley (DEN) defends McCollum (POR) with two hands during the inbound but the contact is marginal.
Aminu (POR) is firming up in a screening position in Beasley's (DEN) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Murray (DEN) moves his pivot foot prior to the release of his dribble.
Turner (POR) briefly holds Jokic (DEN) before lifting his leg into his body as he moves across the lane, but the contact is marginal.
McCollum (POR) makes contact to the arm of Murray (DEN) and affects his SQBR.
Layman (POR) sets the screen in Craig's (DEN) path and does not prevent him from disengaging from the contact.
Millsap (DEN) legally contests the jump shot attempt by Lillard (POR).
